skills.name: Semantic versioning policy
skills.description: Adopt SemVer rigorously.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Write the versioning policy (file.write).
2. Classify API changes before release.
3. Tag releases with the scheme.
4. Verify changelog matches.
5. Automate checks.

skills.name: Lockfile auditing
skills.description: Audit dependency locks.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read lockfiles.
2. python.run_file: duplicate/major-conflict detection.
3. Cross-check against advisories (web.search).
4. Propose bumps.
5. Record.

skills.name: License scanning
skills.description: Check license compatibility.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Enumerate deps (file.read manifests).
2. Fetch licenses (web.search per package).
3. Flag incompatible licenses (python.run_file).
4. Recommend replacements.
5. Record matrix.

skills.name: Transitive dependency mapping
skills.description: Map full dep trees.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Run dependency task (gradle.exec dependencies / npm ls).
2. Parse tree (python.run_file).
3. Find version convergence issues.
4. Propose forced alignments.
5. Record.

skills.name: Dependency vulnerability watch
skills.description: Continuous CVE matching.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Export dep list (SBOM).
2. Match against advisories (web.search feeds).
3. Rank by severity+reachability.
4. File upgrade tasks.
5. Report.

skills.name: Abandoned dependency detection
skills.description: Find unmaintained packages.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Check last release dates (web.search).
2. Flag >2y dormant packages.
3. Assess replacement candidates.
4. Plan migrations.
5. Record.

skills.name: Dependency proxy setup
skills.description: Control dependency inflow.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Configure proxy/mirror for builds (file.patch).
2. Allowlist registries.
3. Log fetches.
4. Review quarterly.
5. Document.

skills.name: Commit pinning for actions
skills.description: Pin CI actions to SHAs.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List workflow actions (file.read).
2. Replace tags with SHAs (file.patch).
3. Dependabot for updates.
4. Verify CI green.
5. Record.

skills.name: Artifact checksum verification
skills.description: Verify downloaded deps.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Enable checksum verification in builds (file.patch).
2. Pin checksums for critical artifacts.
3. Verify builds fail on mismatch.
4. Document policy.
5. Record.

skills.name: Private registry setup
skills.description: Host internal packages.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Set up registry (user/infra).
2. Publish internal libs (process.exec).
3. Configure auth via env (no secrets in repo).
4. Verify resolution.
5. Document.
